args.prompt: Describe the location and extent of air collections in the mediastinum, pericardium, and pleural spaces in both images. Specifically identify whether air is seen along the left/right heart border (suggesting pneumopericardium), along the aortic knob or paraspinal lines (suggesting pneumomediastinum), and whether a visceral pleural line with absent peripheral lung markings is present (suggesting pneumothorax). Compare changes between the two images.
